cohort: The study analyzed administrative data on Cesarean deliveries across all Italian regions in 2017.
finding: The fractal analysis demonstrated that chaos is largely involved in the Cesarean delivery phenomenon across all Italian regions, and regions with more than one type of healthcare institute showed evanescent similar fractal shapes.
mod_finding: Chaos is largely involved in the Cesarean delivery phenomenon in all Italian regions and in Italy, suggesting a lack of clear, predictable patterns in Cesarean delivery rates.
